author: ArkhamJoshFTW
body:
Ok I was messing around with one of my friends explaining to him a story. Then he wouldn't stop playing CSGO. So I thought hey why don't I flip from chats NO ONE WAS IN, to his chats. I do this a few times until I get a headace and tired. I also went in one persons chat and said boo once but they didn't mind. About 10 minutes later we are talking and I was trying to get him to come out of the Spanish chat but he was busy or AFK so I wait for him. Then all of a sudden out of no where I here "You were banned from the server." Not a single message or warning from anyone. Also my teamspeak was lagging and I only saw users in chats for a blink second before I was banned. By the way, I needed to be put on trial and know my punishment for the Michael issue which is showing biased in favor of michael for me being banned before knowing my punishment at all. This is a complete abuse of power and I am outraged. I think bias avicus staff members should be demoted. 

Thank you for your time.
